scientific_conclusion: The barrier-normal wind (ctx_u_perp) and mountain Froude number (ctx_mountain_froude) representation did not provide robust incremental predictive value beyond the existing Stage 8.1 37-feature set under the locked EVEN protocol. This does not imply that mountain-flow physics or orographic effects do not exist, but rather that these particular scalar surface-to-700hPa flow representations do not improve the benchmark model.
research_space_reduction: Deliberately moving away from already-tested generic meteorological state representations (surface obs, NWP 3D condensate, NWP spread, orographic flow scalar features) toward genuinely independent cloud-evolution information (e.g. satellite NRT cloud motion/displacement).
